stories.title: TikTok drops appeal against £12.7m fine for not keeping under-13s off platform
stories.summary: TikTok dropped its appeal and will pay a £12.7 million fine imposed by the UK Information Commissioner’s Office. The regulator fined the platform in 2023 for failing to adequately enforce its minimum age and remove users younger than 13.

stories.title: Lenore review – incel’s obsession with online influencer turns into anatomy of dislocated digital-age mindset
stories.summary: The Australian psychodrama Lenore follows Max Wren, a dangerously disaffected shut-in whose obsession with an online influencer becomes a portrait of a digitally alienated mindset. The Guardian’s review says the film tracks his screen-filled, parasocial mania but does not fully get inside his mind.
